notes: Route: RouteProvider.cs:45 maps "{lang}/register/" to Customer/Register; the form posts to it by route name.
RegisterValidator (FluentValidation) runs on the model before the action; its failures make ModelState invalid so the registration block at line 1063 is skipped and the form is redisplayed.

The Register POST has [ValidateHoneypot] and [ValidateCaptcha]; CaptchaHttpClient.cs:62 `await _httpClient.GetStringAsync(url)` is the HTTP call to the CAPTCHA verifier (only when a CAPTCHA response is posted and CAPTCHA is enabled).
Password hashing/encryption calls inside RegisterCustomerAsync (EncryptText, CreateSaltKey, CreatePasswordHash) are not listed as steps.
Entity inserts and updates also publish EntityInsertedEvent / EntityUpdatedEvent through the repository; those consumers are not listed.
Registration types: Disabled returns early; EmailValidation, AdminApproval and Standard are the switch cases; any other value takes default.
isApproved is true only for UserRegistrationType.Standard (line 1070), which sets Customer.Active.
The step at line 1345 is reached for invalid models, for failed registration results and after the catch.
